item.text: {"decisions":[{"item_id":"feed:3e4b2bb785365a0f4d2f5c33","version_id":"3ba5885426c01d6e011607eb1887958395a1caede359264032947d2f34de76a0","decision":"reject","reason":"The October 15 announcement is within the September 17–October 16 freshness window, but describes generic creation of websites, games and polls rather than an inspectable customer, competitor or market-research workflow. Executive quotations support attributed capabilities, not research accuracy or savings; Bluesky has a commercial incentive to increase platform activity. Poll creation alone supplies no evidence about recruitment, analysis or validation. No cross-post is established by the supplied evidence.","piece_ids":[]},{"item_id":"feed:47caddd09131f10546842b2b","version_id":"91b96960ebd630839c6f5ec7697fbc7d6335a54de7117668d779ae465fe1e21d","decision":"accept","reason":"The October 9 hands-on account adds documented retrieval and task-completion failures beyond the older September 14 beta release. Exact passages describing missed Signal messages, unspecified search coverage and lost route context support practical checks for AI customer-feedback retrieval and multistep research workflows: inspect searched sources, missing coverage and final outputs. The author discloses devices, connections and one or two runs per request, making this credible as attributed observations, not a controlled effectiveness or time-saving comparison. Personal US examples and an English beta do not establish small-business or non-English applicability; costs, customer-data consent and handling remain untested. No commercial relationship or cross-post is established in the supplied evidence.","piece_ids":["02","03"]},{"item_id":"feed:48efe71c79575654d983f408","version_id":"6e238d0d5a039854473bcba99f683e3c49fd5a7c759e782323c029fbd8825396","decision":"reject","reason":"The October 9 interview is recent but concerns consumer-AI monetization and investment opportunities, without a usable market-research workflow or evaluation of evidence quality. Moore's venture-capital role creates material commercial incentives; app rankings and household-payment statistics lack inspectable methods here, and cheaper-model explanations are explicitly speculative. US household figures cannot establish small-business affordability or effectiveness. This shares TechCrunch as publisher with the Attie article and cannot supply another independent publisher; no cross-post or repeated underlying announcement is established.","piece_ids":[]},{"item_id":"feed:4db68c2469ea7a1408d3b0cc","version_id":"9a323abf43a54c0581fdb3997cd83be821eeeb4429f3931fcd87e3dcbfee03f6","decision":"reject","reason":"The September 24 article is recent but addresses UK financial-services brand affinity, not how small businesses use AI to gather or validate research evidence. Its statement about younger customers taking financial questions to AI is incidental. STRAT7 promotes its own research services and report, while the supplied text omits sample sizes, recruitment, field dates and question wording supporting generational percentages and loyalty conclusions. Those claims cannot establish causation or transfer beyond the stated UK sector. No cross-post or repeated underlying claim is established among these candidates.","piece_ids":[]}]}
